items.name: Brave
items.description: Download Brave — a fast web browser for Windows with a built-in adblocker for free download. Enjoy reduced website loading times and enhanced privacy with data encryption and cookie blocking. Safe free download.

items.name: Brave-Search-Rerank
items.description: Personalized reranking converted from Brave Search Quick Tune cookies

items.name: cookie-banner-killer-firefox
items.description: Firefox extension that removes cookie banners using EasyList, uBlock and Brave filter lists.

items.name: chrome-offline-to-brave
items.description: Migrate a full Chrome profile (cookies, passwords, bookmarks) from a mounted, powered-off Windows drive to Brave on Linux, with an offline defeat of Chrome App-Bound Encryption (Chrome 137+). Windows is never booted.

items.name: browser-dig
items.description: BrowserDig (Browser Digital Information Gatherer) is a fast, lightweight, cross-platform browser forensics tool for DFIR, threat hunting, and privacy audits. It extracts and analyze history, cookies, logins, downloads, bookmarks, and more from multiple browsers like Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, and Safari.

items.name: opera-gx-to-brave-session-transfer
items.description: Local, temporary Chromium extension to move login sessions (cookies) from Opera GX to Brave on Windows. Encrypted export, no network.

items.name: cookie-tracker-guide
items.description: Interactive cookie & tracker guide: first-party vs third-party cookies explained, an interactive demo of the profile trackers build about you, and step-by-step third-party cookie blocking walkthroughs for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge and Brave. Includes a local account with a personal tracker-cleanup task list and progress tracking.

items.name: rookie-cookies
items.description: Cross-platform browser cookie extraction and decryption for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, Firefox, and Safari. Extract cookies from browser profiles and decrypt browser cookies into cookie jars using Rust, Python, Node.js, or CLI on Windows, macOS, and Linux—including Chrome App-Bound Encryption v20 and IElevator2.

items.name: idm-cookie-importer-2026
items.description: Import cookies from Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Brave into IDM to unlock downloads from login-protected sites like streaming platforms and file hosts.

items.name: Browser-Data-Grabber
items.description: 🛠️ Build and customize advanced data extraction tools for Windows, enhancing your red team operations and penetration testing with anti-detection features.

items.name: veil-browser
items.description: Navegador para Windows focado em privacidade. Bloqueia anúncios e rastreadores, remove cookies de terceiros, apaga o histórico ao fechar, aceita extensões do Chrome e tem modo de leitura. Você escolhe o buscador: DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing, Brave, Startpage ou Ecosia. Feito com Electron.

items.name: cookie-manager
items.description: Cookie editor for Chrome & Brave — view, add, edit, delete, import & export cookies for the current site. MV3, zero dependencies, no build step.

items.name: consent-buttons
items.description: One-click cookie choices for every site — universal MV3 browser extension (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Firefox / Safari).

items.name: cookielens
items.description: Editor & pengelola cookie untuk Chrome / Edge / Brave — lihat, buat, ubah, hapus, ekspor, dan impor cookie dalam satu panel yang rapi. **100% offline: tanpa iklan, tanpa telemetry, tanpa remote code.**

items.name: brave-browser-mcp

items.name: C00ki3-M0nst3r
items.description: C00ki3 M0nst3r is a standalone Windows utility that extracts sessionid, csrftoken, and xsrftoken authentication cookies from local browser SQLite databases. Supports Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Opera, and Vivaldi. Designed for security research and personal (or not) session recovery without requiring a Python runtime.
